name: Duties Of A Wife
overview: Scripture reveals that the wife was created as a suitable helper for her husband, designed to complement and support him (Genesis 2:18). Her role includes a respectful submission to her husband as to the Lord, reflecting a divinely ordained order within marriage (Ephesians 5:22). The Bible also highlights the value of a virtuous woman, describing her as a crown to her husband and of far greater worth than rubies (Proverbs 12:4, 31:10). Furthermore, the marital bond is to be honored, with Jesus teaching that divorce and remarriage are only permissible under specific circumstances, underscoring the seriousness of the wife's commitment (Matthew 19:9).
